question: How does bank of America consumer revenue compare with jp morgan chase for q2 2025

answer.question: How does bank of America consumer revenue compare with jp morgan chase for q2 2025
answer.text:
JPMorgan Chase's Consumer & Community Banking reported revenue of $18,847 million in Q2 2025 (managed/FTE basis). [bb1e4f91429a5318bdcd]

Bank of America's Consumer Banking reported revenue of $10,813 million in Q2 2025 (FTE basis). [ad2f5ad6749f9c5e11f1]

JPMorgan Chase's reported figure was $8,034 million higher (approximately 74.3% above Bank of America). [bb1e4f91429a5318bdcd] [ad2f5ad6749f9c5e11f1]

This compares reported consumer segments; differences in segment scope and reporting basis limit like-for-like interpretation.
